doc:
Offline exact-content reuse analysis for LifeMem retrieval results.

This script intentionally has no AgentMon or LifeMem runtime dependencies.  It
uses ``results[]`` as the retrieved-memory inventory and ``formatted_context``
as the source of truth for which chunk bodies actually entered the context.
All positions are zero-based Python character offsets with an exclusive end.

injects correlation headers when extra_headers is explicit. Promote the
profile's headers into query kwargs before entering that unchanged wrapper.

Fail-closed DeepSeek-V4 compressed-state intervention helper.

This module is imported by the patched runtime only when
``DSV4_STATE_INTERVENTION`` is not ``off``.  It intentionally has no import-time
dependency on torch; the external-artifact path imports torch lazily.

Single-request DeepSeek-V4 state-intervention precheck runner.

The server process must be restarted with the mode for each intervention case.
Use ``prepare`` before starting E1/E2/E3, then ``run`` after the endpoint is
ready.  E0 runs against the unpatched baseline and needs no preparation.
